description: Risk/reward ratio of a planned trade, the win rate it needs to break even, and (optionally) an exit expressed as an R multiple. Computed with the same function as Clear Tape's free risk/reward and r-multiple calculator page (linked in the result), not estimated. Returns the inputs, each result with its unit, the formula and the page link. Educational, not investment advice.

entry.description: Entry price per share in USD.

exit.description: Optional: an actual or planned exit price in USD, returned as an R multiple.

lang.description: Language of the returned text: "en" (default) or "zh" (Simplified Chinese).

stop.description: Stop price per share in USD; not equal to the entry.

target.description: Target price per share in USD, on the other side of the entry from the stop.

name: calculate_risk_reward
title: Risk/reward and R-multiple calculator
